---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with a machine, recipe, build, or the documentation
---

<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->

For vulnerabilities, use the private route in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/devdocsorg/meta-qcom-3rdparty/blob/docs/layer-documentation/SECURITY.md).
Search existing issues before submitting and remove confidential information.

## Problem

Describe the problem and identify the affected machine, recipe, file, branch,
or commit.

## Reproduction

Give the smallest sequence of steps that shows the problem, such as the exact
`kas-container` command and the kas fragments used.

## Expected and actual result

Explain what should happen and what happens instead. Include error messages and
the failing BitBake task log as text.

## Context

Include the distribution (`nodistro` or `qcom-distro`), the layer revisions,
and related issues. Omit fields that do not apply to the problem.
